evidence.observation: Pressure stable at 3.003 Torr early in growth
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.227 Torr (~+0.05 Torr per event) with no setpoint change
Ar flow steady at ~99-100 sccm, so the rise is not caused by extra gas flow
Thermocouple steady at 749.8 °C and heater power steady at ~44%, so the thermal side looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; the growth atmosphere cannot be checked

args.missing_evidence: Need an O2/air reading or a leak-up (rate-of-rise) test with gas flow stopped to tell an air seal leak (O2 would rise) from an exhaust/pump blockage (no O2). Characterization of the sample is not available yet.
